        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

<li><a href="/about/privacy.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Privacy Policy</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org/about/privacy.html</li>
<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Issues</a> - <span class="caps">GNOME</span>&nbsp;Gitlab</li>
<li><a href="//www.gtk.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> ToolKit</a> -&nbsp;www.gtk.org</li>

                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="//www.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="/about/privacy.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Privacy Policy</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org/about/privacy.html</li>
<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Issues</a> - <span class="caps">GNOME</span>&nbsp;Gitlab</li>
<li><a href="//www.gtk.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> ToolKit</a> -&nbsp;www.gtk.org</li>

        <div class="row clearfix">
            <div class="column full">
                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="//www.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="/about/privacy.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Privacy Policy</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org/about/privacy.html</li>
<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Issues</a> - <span class="caps">GNOME</span>&nbsp;Gitlab</li>
<li><a href="//www.gtk.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> ToolKit</a> -&nbsp;www.gtk.org</li>
<li><a href="//www.gnu.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Project</a> -&nbsp;www.gnu.org</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a> - <span class="caps">GPL</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-rss-feeds"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> <span class="caps">RSS</span> Feeds<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-rss-feeds" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="/feeds/atom.xml">Atom&nbsp;Feed</a></li>
<li><a href="/feeds/rss.xml"><span class="caps">RSS</span>&nbsp;Feed</a></li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues.atom?state=opened"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Active&nbsp;Bugs</a></li>
</ul>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>

                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

</html>https://www.gimp.org/aboutd="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>

            <div class="column full">
                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="//www.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="/about/privacy.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Privacy Policy</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org/about/privacy.html</li>
<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Issues</a> - <span class="caps">GNOME</span>&nbsp;Gitlab</li>
<li><a href="//www.gtk.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> ToolKit</a> -&nbsp;www.gtk.org</li>
<li><a href="//www.gnu.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Project</a> -&nbsp;www.gnu.org</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a> - <span class="caps">GPL</span></li>
</ul>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>

                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>

                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>

                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>

        <div class='container'>

                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>

<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Issues</a> - <span class="caps">GNOME</span>&nbsp;Gitlab</li>

                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>

                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>

It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

        <div class='container'>

                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

            <div class="column full">
                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="//www.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="/about/privacy.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Privacy Policy</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org/about/privacy.html</li>
<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Issues</a> - <span class="caps">GNOME</span>&nbsp;Gitlab</li>
<li><a href="//www.gtk.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> ToolKit</a> -&nbsp;www.gtk.org</li>

</ul>

                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>

            <div class="column full">
                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="//www.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="/about/privacy.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Privacy Policy</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org/about/privacy.html</li>
<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Issues</a> - <span class="caps">GNOME</span>&nbsp;Gitlab</li>
<li><a href="//www.gtk.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> ToolKit</a> -&nbsp;www.gtk.org</li>
<li><a href="//www.gnu.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Project</a> -&nbsp;www.gnu.org</li>

                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>

<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>

            <div class="column full">
                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimprc.html"><tt>gimprc</tt> (5)</a></li>
<li><a href="/man/gimptool.html"><tt>gimptool-2.0</tt> (1)</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="important-gimp-links">Important <span class="caps">GIMP</span> Links<a class="headerlink" href="#important-gimp-links" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="//www.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="/about/privacy.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Privacy Policy</a> -&nbsp;www.gimp.org/about/privacy.html</li>
<li><a href="https://developer.gimp.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developer Website</a> -&nbsp;developer.gimp.org</li>
<li><a href="https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gimp/issues"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Issues</a> - <span class="caps">GNOME</span>&nbsp;Gitlab</li>
<li><a href="//www.gtk.org"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> ToolKit</a> -&nbsp;www.gtk.org</li>

                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>

                <h1>About <span class="caps">GIMP</span></h1>
                
            </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/linking.html">Linking to us, including images of&nbsp;Wilber</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/selling.html">Is it legal to sell copies of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/everywhere.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> everywhere - where and how <span class="caps">GIMP</span> is&nbsp;used</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-manual-pages"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Manual Pages<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-manual-pages" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <code>man</code> pages for command line usage of <span class="caps">GIMP</span>:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/man/gimp.html"><tt>gimp</tt> (1)</a></li>

                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="gimp-stuff"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Stuff<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-stuff" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>

<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> authors and&nbsp;contributors</a></li>

                <div class='column full'>
                    <h2 id="introduction">Introduction<a class="headerlink" href="#introduction" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p><span class="caps">GIMP</span> is an acronym for <span class="caps">GNU</span> Image Manipulation Program.
It is a freely distributed program for such tasks as photo retouching, image composition and image authoring.
The terms of usage and rules about copying are clearly listed in the <a href="/about/COPYING"><span class="caps">GNU</span> General Public License</a>.
There is a nice <a href="https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html">Frequently Asked Questions (<span class="caps">FAQ</span>)</a>&nbsp;page.</p>
<h2 id="gimp-history"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> History<a class="headerlink" href="#gimp-history" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/prehistory.html">Prehistory</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 0.54 in&nbsp;1996</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/ancient_history.html">Ancient History</a> - until <span class="caps">GIMP</span> 1.0 in&nbsp;1998</li>
<li><a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/history.html">History</a> - from 1.0 to <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;2.8.4</li>
</ul>
